title: A4 agent output (a4-subtopic-writer)
description: Section 9/A4 'Agent output' line and the a4-subtopic-writer agent file (Appendix B). This is the shape of ONE run (run A or run B); the script merges the two (adjudicating disagreements) before writing ncert/subtopics/<CHAPTER>.json (Section 6.4), whose shape differs (adds subtopic_id, version, approval).

n.description: Draft sequence number; the script assigns the real ST01... id.

name.description: Describes the idea, not the page.

from_heading.description: The book's own heading number/text this subtopic is drawn from.

passages.description: Passage IDs this subtopic covers; every chapter passage must be covered by >= 1 subtopic (the A4 check).
